description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cooper Rush told reporters he took all the reps with the first-team in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: This comes after Tua Tagovailoa reportedly went down during individual drills as he was holding his back. This will remain a situation to monitor on Friday, but it looks like Rush could be starting on Sunday.
items.title: Cooper Rush takes first-team reps for Falcons Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) was listed as a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Worthy seems to be over his shoulder injury and was able to practice in full on Thursday. He should be a full go for Week 1 but doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option in a matchup against the Broncos.
items.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) listed as full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III (foot) is off of the injury report ahead of Monday night's game against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Walker was previously dealing with a foot injury of some kind, but he is over it now and is no longer listed on the team's injury report ahead of their Week 1 matchup against the Broncos. Fantasy managers should expect him to be highly involved on Monday night, although the tough matchup may hurt his ceiling from a fantasy perspective.
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (foot) off injury report for Monday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Trey Smith (hip) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith was battling through a hip injury earlier in the offseason, but he was a full participant at Thursday's practice and will likely be good to go for Week 1. His presence will be very necessary for Kansas City's offensive line ahead of a tough matchup against Denver's elite defense.
items.title: Trey Smith (hip) full participant at practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Josh Simmons (back) did not take part in Kansas City's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Simmons is not expected to be available to play in Week 1, and he wasn't able to practice on Thursday, which is further confirmation of that report. Kahlil Benson is expected to be the starter in his likely absence, which is bad news for the Chiefs, as he is an inexperienced rookie facing up against one of the best defensive fronts in the entire league.
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) doesn't practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Rashee Rice (knee) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Rice was able to log a full practice session on Thursday and seems to be set to play in Monday night's game against the Denver Broncos. Despite the tough matchup, he projects to be a good fantasy option in PPR leagues this week, especially with Patrick Mahomes II (knee) likely to be at the helm for Kansas City.
items.title: Rashee Rice (knee) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Mahomes was able to take part in Kansas City's first practice of the week on Thursday and wasn't limited in any way. It seems like the team is planning on him starting on Monday night, barring any unforeseen setbacks. His presence would be great news for the fantasy value of players like Rashee Rice and Travis Kelce in a matchup against a tough Denver defense.
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) practices in full Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Luke Schoonmaker (personal) missed Dallas' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Schoonmaker was absent from practice on Thursday due to what is being described as a personal issue of some kind. We should get more clarity regarding his status for Week 1 sometime after Friday's practice.
items.title: Luke Schoonmaker (personal) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tee Higgins (foot) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: The Bengals will likely have Higgins for their season opener on Sunday, as he has been a full participant at two-straight practices to start the week. Fantasy managers should feel confident starting him if he's fully cleared to play prior to kickoff against the Buccaneers.
items.title: Tee Higgins (foot) practices in full again Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Billy Schrauth was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Schrauth is on track to be good to go for Sunday after back-to-back full practices.
items.title: Billy Schrauth (knee) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Chase was able to log yet another full practice session on Thursday. He is trending towards being a full go for the season opener on Sunday, assuming there are no unforeseen setbacks between now and then. He will be a top-tier fantasy option if active in Week 1 and beyond.
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bain suffered an AC sprain two weeks ago. His return to a full practice on Thursday puts him on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sean Tucker was listed as a limited participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tucker made his return after he was absent from practice on Wednesday. With one more limited session, he should be good to go for Sunday's season opener.
items.title: Sean Tucker (hamstring) officially limited in practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kamara continues to beat expectations with his injury timeline, participating in a second-straight practice again on Thursday. He remained limited, but there have been reports that he is trending towards playing in Week 1 of the season. If that's the case, that will be negative news for the fantasy value of Kendre Miller moving forward.
items.title: Alvin Kamara (knee) listed as limited again Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Justin Skule remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Skule has been limited back-to-back days to start the week. He should be good to go for Sunday with at least one more limited practice on Friday.
items.title: Justin Skule (oblique) limited in practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Rozeboom was limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Rozeboom has been limited back-to-back days to start the week. He should be good to go for Sunday with at least one more limited practice on Friday.
items.title: Christian Rozeboom (foot) limited in practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Audric Estime (thigh) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Saints held their second official practice of the week on Thursday, but Estime was again not able to participate with the team. It looks like he is going to be sidelined for Week 1, and it's unclear how much more time he will need before making his return to the lineup.
items.title: Audric Estime (thigh) non-participant Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen McMillan was a limited participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McMillan has now been limited back-to-back days. He should be good to go on Sunday with another limited session on Friday.
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) limited in practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka remained a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Egbuka has now posted back-to-back full practices, leaving him well on track to be good to go for Week 1. He is an upside WR2 heading into the season and could be part of one of the higher-scoring games of the week on Sunday against the Bengals.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) logs another full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Breece Hall (groin) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall has been a full participant in two-straight practices to start the week. He told reporters earlier that will be good to go for Week 1, so fantasy managers shouldn't have any real hesitations with starting him ahead of the first game of the season.
items.title: Breece Hall (groin) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tim Patrick (groin) missed New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like the veteran wideout is going to miss this week's game, as he has been a non-participant at both of New York's practices to start the week. Look for Adonai Mitchell and rookie Omar Cooper Jr. to benefit from his absence if that's the case.
items.title: Tim Patrick (groin) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It was previously reported that Allen would be a game-time decision this weekend, and it looks like that may still be the case. He was upgraded to a limited participant on Thursday, which gives him a chance to play this weekend but doesn't strongly indicate that he will. If he's ruled out, look for Chris Rodriguez Jr. to benefit from his absence from a fantasy perspective.
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) upgraded to limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was again limited on Thursday as he continues to recover from a thumb injury of some kind. He is already expected to play this weekend, although he may still be left with an injury designation heading into the weekend if he doesn't practice in full on Friday.
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Teven Jenkins (back) missed Cleveland's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jenkins was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday after being limited at practice on Wednesday. It seems like he is going to be sidelined in Week 1, which is bad news for an offense that already projects to be one of the NFL's worst over the course of the season.
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Flowers has been dealing with a hamstring injury for a while, but it seems that he is finally over it, as he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He should be good to go in Week 1 and can be safely started in most league formats, especially PPR leagues.
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) upgraded to full participant Thursday

title: Fantasy Player News
